content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Platform stripe

Stripe and PayPal offer a range of features, including payment processing, invoicing, and subscription management, but their limited geographic availability makes them inaccessible to many creators. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions like COREMERCH provide a comprehensive suite of tools, including hosting, backend logic, order storage, and payment processing, that can be deployed in any country, giving creators full control over their online stores and customer data.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195, leaving a significant portion of the global population without access to its services. PayPal's account suspension policy can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal, making it a risky choice for creators who rely on timely payments. Sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions, on the other hand, are designed to work in any country, providing a reliable and secure payment experience for creators and their customers.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal charge transaction fees that can range from 2.9% to 4.4%, plus a fixed fee per transaction, which can eat into creators' profits. Sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions like COREMERCH, which utilize NOWPayments, charge a flat 0.5% fee per transaction, with no hidden costs or surprises, making it a more cost-effective option for creators who want to maximize their earnings.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions offer creators full ownership and control over their online stores.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With Stripe and PayPal, creators are at the mercy of the platform's terms and conditions, which can change at any time, potentially disrupting their business. Sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions, on the other hand, provide creators with full ownership and control over their online stores, automated payment processing, and instant product delivery, giving them the freedom to run their business as they see fit.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators who value flexibility, control, and cost-effectiveness, sovereign commerce infrastructure solutions like COREMERCH are the clear choice. With the ability to deploy a fully functional online store in 48 hours, creators can start selling their digital products and reaching their customers without relying on restrictive platforms like Stripe and PayPal.
